business.name: Kong Pocha
business.tagline: Korean comfort food, late-night vibes, legendary fried chicken.
business.description: Kong Pocha is Columbia's late-night Korean comfort food spot — a rustic-modern eatery with a retro 70s vibe where the fried chicken is legendary and the soju flows freely. Started by Sobin Kang, who built a cult following at the original Baltimore location on W. 20th St, the Columbia outpost brings the same home-cooked Korean fare — kimchi pancakes, spicy rice cakes, smoky BBQ, and crispy chicken in half a dozen styles — to Howard County. Open until 1am most nights. Walk-ins welcome.
business.address: 9350 Snowden River Pkwy, Suite J, Columbia, MD 21045
business.pull_quote: The kind of place where you order one plate of chicken and somehow stay until midnight.

items.name: Sweet Corn Pancake
items.description: Crispy potato starch pancake with sweet corn and condensed milk.

items.name: Corn Cheese
items.description: Melted mozzarella baked over sweet corn. Best eaten straight from the skillet.

items.name: Kimchi Jeon
items.description: Savory kimchi scallion pancake with crispy edges and a chewy center.

items.name: Tteokbokki (Spicy Rice Cake)
items.description: Chewy rice cakes in a rose cream sauce — spicy, sweet, and completely addictive.

items.name: Butter Fried Chicken
items.description: Bone-in, golden, buttery, and impossible to stop eating. The signature Kong Pocha bird.

items.name: Soy Garlic Fried Chicken
items.description: Sticky soy-garlic glaze, crackly outside, juicy inside. A perennial favorite.

items.name: Spicy Chicken with Cheese
items.description: Double trouble: the heat of gochujang balanced with a blanket of melted cheese.

items.name: Sweet & Spicy Fried Chicken
items.description: The original Kong Pocha style. Crowd-pleasing, glossy, and totally satisfying.

items.name: Bulgogi
items.description: Thinly sliced marinated beef, sweet and savory. Served sizzling on the grill.

items.name: Army Stew (Budae Jjigae)
items.description: A Korean classic: spam, sausage, ramen noodles, and kimchi in a rich broth.

items.name: Mala Seafood Cream Udon
items.description: Rich and numbing mala broth with fresh seafood and thick udon noodles.

items.name: Soju
items.description: Classic Korean distilled spirit. Served ice cold. Goes with everything.

items.name: Draft Beer
items.description: Korean and domestic options on tap.
